title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Crop
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Crop. A collection of cultivated plants that is grown on a large scale commercially, especially a cereal, fruit, or vegetable. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (SAREF core class, not modeled here). A Crop is grown on some Parcel (geo:sfContains, from the Parcel side) and is related to measurements via saref:FeatureOfInterest. NOTE: the official dataModel.Agrifood subject publishes a conceptually similar but differently-named 'AgriCrop' entity.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Crop'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. The name of the crop (e.g. a cultivar/variety name such as 'Sweet Corn' or 'Sugar Snaps', per the ex:Sweet_Corn_1 / ex:Sugar_Snaps_1 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1).

taxonRank.description: Property. obo:TAXRANK_1000000 some obo:TAXRANK_0000000, reusing the OBO TAXRANK taxonomy vocabulary. The taxonomic classification of the crop species.

datePlanted.description: Property. s4agri:hasPlantDate some xsd:dateTime. The day the crop is planted.

dateHarvested.description: Property. s4agri:hasHarvestDate some xsd:dateTime. The day the crop is harvested.

isContainedInParcel.description: Relationship. geo:sfWithin (inverse of geo:sfContains). The Parcel this Crop is grown in.

receives.description: Relationship, documented in ETSI TS 103 410-6 Table 4 as 's4agri:receives some s4agri:Intake' (e.g. fertilizer intake of the crop). Example value is the IRI of the s4agri:Intake named individual (saref:Property).

generates.description: Relationship. s4agri:generates some s4agri:Yield, subPropertyOf saref:hasProperty. The yield (e.g. harvested crop quantity) generated by this crop.
